title: Item:Lolth, The Spider Queen Cookie

__NOTOC__ [[File:Lolth Cookie big.jpg|right|113px|Lolth, The Spider Queen Cookie]] ''Gingerbread cookie baked into the shape of a demonic spider.'' Named after [[Lolth]], the Queen of Spiders or Queen of the Demonweb. Lolth, The Spider Queen Cookies were first introduced during [[Midwinter Festival]] in 2013 and have been taken over to [[Snowpeaks Festival]]. == 2013 - Current == {{Consumable |picdesc = Lolth, The Spider Queen Cookie (2021).png |acquired = [[Flurry (NPC)|Flurry ]] |location = [[Hall of Heroes]], Eberron |turnin = [[Snowpeaks Festival]]: {{SnowpeaksIngredient | ing_Bronze = 10 }}, probability >3% |minlevel = 1 |bind = {{Bind|no}} |effect = [[Wand of a Wonder]]: ** Blessing of Lolth: +2 [[Profane bonus]] to [[attack]] and [[damage roll]]s, +3 [[Profane bonus]] to [[Physical Resistance]], +5 [[Profane bonus]] to [[Universal Spell Power]]. - Duration: 1 minute (CL: 10) |durability = 5 |material = Flesh |hardness = 0 |cost = 5 pp |weight = 0.01 lbs |description = Gingerbread cookie baked into the shape of a demonic spider.
Eating this cookie provides you with Lolth's Blessing, granting a +2 Profane bonus to attack and damage rolls, a +3 Profane bonus to Physical Resistance, and a +5 Profane bonus to Universal Spell Power. |notes = According to the announcement of the Midwinter Festival in {{Plain link|url=https://www.ddo.com/en/news/ddo-chronicle-issue-405|name=The DDO Chronicle - issue 405}} this event has been retired with the upcoming Snowpeaks Festival. |Category1 = Snowpeaks Festival potions |Category2 = Snowpeaks Festival reward items }}
